sections.heading: Registration, title, insurance and inspection — D
sections.markdown:
# Accuracy and teaching notes

The guide’s state-tax percentage, fees, temporary-plate duration, transfer/address deadlines, seizure cure periods, renewal timing and inspection-program applicability require current issuer/legal verification. Its less-than-ten-year federal odometer rule may be stale and is withheld pending the applicable model-year/current federal rule. Do not equate registration alone with conclusive legal ownership despite the guide’s wording. The municipal inspection reference is a description of the snapshot, not present-day clearance. Preserve explicit currentness debt for the entire administrative section; no transaction advice or current pricing is claimed. [A01] [A02] [A03]
Memory cue, authored product policy: “Assign the title, keep registration current, carry insurance proof”. The cue retrieves complete cited rules and does not replace their conditions.
Terminology: A lien is a secured interest listed on the title; a lien release documents the authorized holder’s release. A public tag agent handles specified vehicle transactions and may add fees.
Misconception to correct: A renewal notice transfers responsibility for registration to the agency, or insurance may be canceled before the plate is surrendered without consequences. The source places responsibility on the owner and gives a surrender-first sequence.
